name: Feya's Swamp

rounds.endCondition: Game ends after the Turn Phase of round 4

categories.label: Victory points on score track
categories.hint: VP gained during the game (actions, celebrations, sailing, etc.).

categories.label: Island scoring
categories.hint: Per island: your Settlements there x number of Spirit spaces on that island. Enter the total over all islands.

categories.label: Card: largest settlement group
categories.labelVi: Thẻ: nhóm khu định cư lớn nhất
categories.hint: Only if this score card is in play. Settlements in your largest connected group, squared.

categories.label: Card: settlements next to Temple
categories.labelVi: Thẻ: khu định cư cạnh Temple
categories.hint: Only if in play. 5 VP per Settlement adjacent to a Temple space.

categories.label: Card: islands with most settlements
categories.hint: Only if in play. 3 VP per island where you have the most Settlements (ties for first count).

categories.label: Card: islands with exactly 1 settlement
categories.labelVi: Thẻ: đảo có đúng 1 khu định cư
categories.hint: Only if in play. 5 VP per island where you have exactly one Settlement.

categories.label: Card: settlements on largest island(s)
categories.labelVi: Thẻ: khu định cư trên đảo lớn nhất
categories.hint: Only if in play. 4 VP per Settlement on the largest island(s).

categories.label: Card: settlements on smallest island(s)
categories.labelVi: Thẻ: khu định cư trên đảo nhỏ nhất
categories.hint: Only if in play. 4 VP per Settlement on the smallest island(s).

categories.label: Fish on your Settlements
categories.labelVi: Cá trên khu định cư của bạn
categories.hint: 1 VP per Fish still on your Settlement tiles.

categories.label: Mana Gems
categories.hint: 1 VP per Mana Gem in personal reserve.

categories.label: Gold
categories.hint: 1 VP per 10 Gold in personal reserve.

tiebreakers.description: No tiebreaker: tied players share the victory.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Only 2 of the 6 score cards are in play each game (scorer enters 0 for cards not in play). Gold category: enter total Gold; points = floor(Gold/10).
